landing.heading: Ikhemistri ye-glaze yamahhala yababumbi.
landing.lead: Qonda ama-glaze akho, ungawaxubi nje kuphela. Faka iresiphi ubone ngaso leso sikhathi i-UMF (unity molecular formula) yayo, isilinganiso sayo se-silica ne-alumina nebhalansi yama-flux ayo. Gcina amaresiphi akho, okokwakha, okokufaka umbala, amanothi namarekhodi okushisa ndawonye encwadini eyodwa eyimfihlo.
landing.trialEnded: Ukuzama kwakho sekuphelile. Qala okusha, noma uvule i-akhawunti yamahhala ukuze ugcine umsebenzi wakho.
landing.trialFailed: Ukuzama akukwazanga ukuqala okwamanje. Sicela uzame futhi.
landing.heroNote: Akudingeki ubhalise ukuze uzame · Kumahhala futhi kungumthombo ovulekile · Amaresiphi akho ahlala eyimfihlo
landing.heroAlt: Umugqa wamaqoqo ama-cone ashisiwe: ama-cone amhlophe eqoqweni ngalinye agobile ngenxa yokushisa kwe-kiln.
landing.heroCaption: Amaqoqo ama-cone ngemva kokushisa: i-cone ngayinye iyagoba uma i-kiln isenze umsebenzi wokushisa owanele.
landing.exampleCaption: I-"4321" kaBernard Leach, evame ukushiswa kuze kube ku-cone 10, ngezingxenye ngesisindo.
landing.exampleNote: Ama-flux ahlangana abe ngu-1, ukuze noma yimaphi ama-glaze amabili aqhathaniswe ngobulungiswa. Kubalwe lapha kusiphequluli sakho ngekhodi efanayo nesebenziswa yisibali.

unity.title: I-UMF ngaso leso sikhathi
unity.text: Bona ama-flux, i-alumina ne-silica ku-unity, njengoba osokhemistri be-glaze beqhathanisa amaresiphi, ngokushesha nje uma ufaka iresiphi.

substitute.title: Lungisa futhi ushintshe
substitute.text: Okokwakha akusakhiqizwa? Qhathanisa ama-formula ukuze uthole okungathatha indawo yakho okuncibilika ngendlela efanayo.

notebook.title: Incwadi yakho yesitudiyo
notebook.text: Gcina amaresiphi, okokwakha kwakho, okokufaka umbala, amanothi namarekhodi okushisa ndawonye endaweni eyodwa.

learn.title: Funda njengoba uqhubeka
learn.text: Imihlahlandlela ngolimi olulula, kusukela ekutheni yini i-glaze kuya ekuyishiseni ngokuphepha, ihlala eduze kwezinombolo.

landing.umfRecipe: Iresiphi ye-glaze isho ukuthi kufanele ukale okungakanani kokokwakha ngakunye. I-UMF, ebizwa nangokuthi i-Seger formula, isho ukuthi lokho okokwakha kuba yini ku-kiln: angaki amamolekyuli e-oxide ngayinye, alinganiswe ukuze ama-flux ahlangane abe ngunye.
landing.umfGroups: Ama-flux enza i-glaze incibilike, i-alumina iqinisa okuncibilikile, futhi i-silica yakha ingilazi. Ukuqhathanisa la maqembu amathathu kuchaza ukuthi kungani i-glaze eyodwa icwebezela kanti enye ingacwebezeli, noma kungani eyodwa igobhoza kanti enye ihlala ilapho, futhi kubonisa ukuthi ungathatha kanjani indawo yokokwakha okungasathengiswa.
landing.closingText: Zama isibali manje, bese uvula i-akhawunti ukuze ugcine lokho okwenzile.

about.title: Mayelana ne-Glazecalc
about.lead: Isibali samahhala nencwadi yekhemistri ye-glaze, enomthombo ovulekile, yababumbi, abasebenza ngobumba nabafundi.
about.what: I-Glazecalc iguqula iresiphi ye-glaze, okokwakha nokuthi ukala okungakanani kokunye nokunye, ibe yi-UMF (unity molecular formula) yayo: ama-oxide akha i-glaze uma isishisiwe, alinganiswe ukuze ama-flux ahlangane abe ngunye. Lokho kwenza amaresiphi aqhathaniseke, kusiza ukuchaza ukuthi i-glaze iziphatha kanjani, futhi kusiza lapho okokwakha kufanele kuthathelwe indawo.
about.alongside: Eceleni kwesibali igcina amaresiphi akho, okokwakha kwakho, okokufaka umbala nezinye izithasiselo, amanothi namarekhodi okushisa, ikhasi le-<advice>seluleko nge-glaze</advice> esiwusizo, kanye <guides>nemihlahlandlela</guides> yababumbi abasha, kusukela ekutheni yini i-glaze kuya ekuyishiseni ngokuphepha.
about.numbers: Okokwakha ngakunye kuchazwa nge-formula yakho yekhemikhali noma ngokuhlaziywa kwama-oxide, kanye ne-LOI (loss on ignition) yakho: ingxenye eshayo ku-kiln, njenge-carbon dioxide ku-whiting noma amanzi ku-kaolin. I-Glazecalc iguqula inani ngalinye libe ama-mole e-oxide ngayinye isebenzisa ama-molar mass ajwayelekile, iwahlanganise kuyo yonke iresiphi, bese ihlukanisa ngenani lonke lama-mole e-flux. Okokufaka umbala nezinye izithasiselo kubhalwa neresiphi kodwa akufakwa ku-UMF, njengokujwayelekile.
about.guide: Imiphumela iwumhlahlandlela, hhayi isiqinisekiso. Okokwakha kwangempela kuyahluka kumphakeli nomphakeli, naku-batch ne-batch, futhi ukushisa kubalulekile njengekhemistri, ngakho hlola yonke i-glaze. Ama-glaze ezindawo zokudla kufanele ahlolelwe ukuphuma kwezinsimbi (leaching).
about.built: I-Glazecalc yaqala ngo-2017 futhi yakhiwa kabusha ngo-2026. Iwuhlelo oluncane olulodwa lwewebhu, futhi <source>ikhodi yayo yomthombo iku-GitHub</source> ngaphansi kwe-MIT License.
about.stackBrowser: I-Angular 22 kusiphequluli (ama-standalone component nama-signal), nekhemistri ye-glaze emtatsheni omncane owabiwe.
about.stackServer: I-API ye-TypeScript ku-Node.js 24 ne-Express 5, ne-MongoDB 9, ihlolwe ngokuhlolwa okuzenzakalelayo okungaphezu kuka-350.
about.stackHosting: Isebenza ku-Docker ku-Amazon Web Services, ngemva kwe-nginx ene-HTTPS evela ku-Let's Encrypt.
about.stackDeploy: Ifakwa yi-GitHub Actions: izithombe zakhiwa futhi zihlolwe kuzo zonke izinguquko, futhi ukufaka kungena ku-AWS ngaphandle kokhiye abagciniwe.
about.credits: Izifunda eshadini le-Stull zivela ekufundeni kwe-Glazy ishadi lika-R. T. Stull lika-1912, nguDerek Au (Copyright (c) 2017 Derek Au, MIT License). <notices>Isaziso esigcwele</notices> sisemthonjeni.
about.who: I-Glazecalc yenziwe ngu-Aaron Filson. Uthole inkinga noma unomqondo? <issues>Vula i-issue ku-GitHub</issues>.
about.studio: Izitsha zobumba ezenziwe ngesandla zika-Aaron Filson zise-<studio>Updraft Pottery Studio</studio> e-Tacoma, Washington. Buka umsebenzi, futhi u-ode isitsha uma esinye sikukhuluma.
about.languages: I-Glazecalc iyatholakala kulezi zilimi. Isixhumanisi ngasinye sivula leli khasi ngalolo limi.

privacy.title: Ubumfihlo
privacy.short: I-Glazecalc igcina lokho ekudingayo ukuze iqhube i-akhawunti yakho, hhayi okunye. Azikho izikhangiso, akukho ukuhlaziywa futhi akukho ukulandelelwa. Imininingwane yakho ayilokothi ithengiswe, futhi okuwukuphela kwenkampani eyiphathayo yi-Amazon Web Services, ephethe isayithi futhi ithumela ama-imeyili ayo.
privacy.who: I-Glazecalc iyiphrojekthi yamahhala, enomthombo ovulekile, engenzi nzuzo, eqhutshwa ngumnikazi wayo, u-Aaron Filson, e-United States. Unquma ukuthi kwenzekani ngemininingwane yakho, ngakho emthethweni wokuvikelwa kwemininingwane ungu-"controller" wayo.
privacy.contact: Ukuze ubuze ngemininingwane yakho, noma usebenzise noma yiliphi ilungelo lakho, bhalela ku-<mail>privacy@glazecalcapp.com</mail>. Ungakwazi futhi <issues>ukuvula i-issue ku-GitHub</issues>, kodwa ama-issue asobala: ungalokothi ufake ikheli lakho le-imeyili noma okuthile okomuntu siqu kuyo. Izinto eziningi ngemininingwane yakho ungazenza wena ekhasini lakho <account>le-akhawunti</account>.
privacy.storedAccount: I-akhawunti yakho: ikheli lakho le-imeyili, nephasiwedi yakho, egcinwe kuphela njenge-hash yendlela eyodwa (bcrypt), hhayi njengephasiwedi uqobo. Izilungiselelo zakho (njengolimi, isifunda namayunithi) nohlu lokokwakha onakho kugcinwa nayo. I-akhawunti idinga ikheli le-imeyili, ukuze ungene futhi usethe kabusha iphasiwedi ekhohliwe. Uma uvula i-akhawunti, kuthunyelwa isixhumanisi ekhelini ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ngelakho; kuze kube yilapho, i-imeyili iya kulo kuphela uma ucela, njengokusetha kabusha iphasiwedi.
privacy.storedShelf: Uhlu lwangaphambi koshintsho lwakho lokugcina kokokwakha onakho: njalo uma lolo hlu lushintsha, kuwebhusayithi, nge-access token noma ngohlelo oluxhunyiwe, uhlu njengoba lwalunjalo ngaphambilini lugcinwa ne-akhawunti yakho, ukuze ushintsho luhlehliswe kanye. Ushintsho olulandelayo luluthatha indawo, futhi ukuhlehlisa ushintsho kulususa. Lukhona kokuthi Landa imininingwane yami, futhi luyahamba uma usula i-akhawunti yakho.
privacy.storedPrices: Amanani, uma uwanikeza: lokho okukhokhayo kokokwakha ngakunye, ngekhilogremu, nemali akuyo, ukuze kubalwe izindleko ze-batch. Ayimininingwane yebhizinisi, egcinwe ne-akhawunti yakho futhi eyimfihlo kuyo: awalokothi abe yingxenye yeresiphi, ngakho akukho okwabelana ngakho okuwabonisayo. Landa imininingwane yami iyawafaka, futhi ukusula i-akhawunti kuyawasula. Amanani okuzama ayangena ku-akhawunti yakho kanye namarekhodi akho, kokokwakha ongakabeki manani kukho, uma kokubili kusemalini efanayo.
privacy.storedEmailChange: Ukushintsha i-imeyili yakho: usuku ikheli lakho elashintsha ngalo okokugcina, ukuze isicelo sokuvala ukungena ngezinyathelo ezimbili singalokothi samukelwe sivela ekhelini elisha ezinsukwini ezingu-30 ezilandelayo.
privacy.storedSignIn: Ukungena ngezinyathelo ezimbili, uma ukuvula: ukuthi kuvuliwe yini; ukhiye uhlelo lwakho lwe-authenticator olwabelana ngalo ne-Glazecalc, obethelwe; ku-passkey ngayinye, ukhiye wayo womphakathi (ongakwazi ukungena wodwa) ne-id nemininingwane edivayisi yakho eyinikezayo, igama oyinike lona, nokuthi yengezwa nini futhi yagcina nini ukusetshenziswa; amakhodi akho okubuyisela, kuphela njenge-hash yendlela eyodwa enokhiye, ukuze kungabikho muntu ongawafunda futhi; futhi, uma othile efaka iphasiwedi yakho kodwa engasiqedi isinyathelo sesibili, nini i-Glazecalc yagcina ukukuthumelela i-imeyili ngalokho (okungeqile kanye ngosuku). Ngenkathi ungena, phakathi kwephasiwedi yakho nesinyathelo sesibili, iseva igcina inothi lokungena imizuzu engu-5, futhi ikhasi libamba i-token emfushane enkumbulweni yalo kuphela: ayikho i-cookie entsha, akukho lutho kusitoreji sesiphequluli sakho.
privacy.storedSaved: Lokho okulondolozayo: amaresiphi akho, okokwakha, izithasiselo, amanothi, amarekhodi okushisa neseluleko, njengoba ukubhalile. Nguwe kuphela ongakubona, ngaphandle uma wabelana ngeresiphi ngesixhumanisi.
privacy.storedTrash: UDoti nezinguqulo zangaphambili: lokho okukhipha ohlwini kulinda kuDoti, kuphelele, ukuze ukwazi ukukubuyisa; futhi ushintsho ngalunye olulondoloza erekhodini lugcina irekhodi njengoba lalinjalo ngaphambilini, ukuze ukwazi ukuhlehlisa ushintsho.
privacy.storedShares: Amaresiphi owabelana ngawo ngesixhumanisi, uma wabelana nganoma yimaphi: iyiphi iresiphi, nini isixhumanisi sayo senziwa nokuthi siyawabonisa yini amanothi eresiphi, ne-hash yendlela eyodwa yesixhumanisi (hhayi isixhumanisi uqobo). Noma ubani onesixhumanisi angayibona iresiphi njengoba injalo manje, ne-UMF yayo, namanothi ayo uma ukhethe ukuwabonisa; hhayi i-imeyili yakho, i-akhawunti yakho noma amanani. Amaresiphi abelwana ngawo agcinwa ngaphandle kwezinjini zokusesha, futhi isixhumanisi asilokothi sifike kuma-log eseva. Ukuvimbela ukuxhashazwa, amaresiphi abelwana ngawo avulwa kusuka ekhelini ngalinye le-IP ayabalwa, enkumbulweni, imizuzu engu-15. Ukuzama akukwazi ukwabelana.
privacy.storedTokens: Ama-access token nezinhlelo ezixhunyiwe, uma wenza noma uvumela noma yikuphi: ngakunye, igama lakho, lokho okungakwenza, nokuthi kwenziwa nini, kwagcina nini ukusetshenziswa, kuphelelwa nini nokuthi kwahoxiswa nini; ku-access token, futhi ne-hash yendlela eyodwa ye-token (hhayi i-token uqobo) nezinhlamvu zayo zokugcina ezingu-4. Lokho okugcinwa ngohlelo oluxhunyiwe kuchazwe ngaphansi kokuthi "Ukuxhuma uhlelo lwe-AI", ngezansi.
privacy.storedActivity: Lokho ama-token nezinhlelo okwenzile: umugqa werekhodi ngalinye i-access token noma uhlelo oluxhunyiwe olwalakha, lwalishintsha, lwaliyisa kuDoti, lwalibuyisa noma lwahlehlisa: nini, iyiphi i-token noma uhlelo, lokho okwenzile nesihloko serekhodi, sifinyeziwe. Akulokothi kube umbhalo wenothi noma okunye okusererekhodini. Izinguquko ozenza kuwebhusayithi azibhalwa. Ubona le migqa ekhasini elithi Izinhlelo ezixhunyiwe, nakokuthi Landa imininingwane yami.
privacy.storedPending: Izinguquko ezilinde imvume yakho, uma ucela ukuqinisekisa izinguquko: uma i-access token noma uhlelo oluxhunyiwe lucela ukushintsha amarekhodi akho futhi ukhethe ukuvumela izinguquko ezinjalo kuqala, ushintsho luyalinda: lokho olungakwenza (okungafaka umbhalo wenothi noma weresiphi), iyiphi i-token noma uhlelo olucelile, nokuthi nini. Nguwe kuphela ongaluvumela, ungenile. Imininingwane yalo isuswa ngokushesha nje uma uluvumela noma uluchitha.
privacy.storedLimits: Imikhawulo yokuthi kaningi kangakanani: ukuvimbela ukuqagela nezikripthi ezingalawuleki, kubalwa imizamo yokungena, ukubhalisa, izicelo zokusetha kabusha nokuzama ngekheli le-IP noma nge-akhawunti, ama-access token angasebenzi ngekheli le-IP, izicelo ezenziwe ngama-access token, nge-akhawunti (120 ngomzuzu no-5,000 ngosuku), izinguquko ezenziwe ngama-access token, nge-akhawunti (60 ngomzuzu no-5,000 ngosuku), amarekhodi i-access token ngayinye ewayisa kuDoti, nge-token, amaresiphi abelwana ngawo avuliwe nezixhumanisi zokwabelana ezingavuli lutho, ngekheli le-IP, nezicelo kumathuluzi abasizi be-AI (MCP): 60 ngomzuzu no-2,000 ngosuku ngekheli le-IP, noma 300 ngomzuzu no-20,000 ngosuku nge-akhawunti uma kusetshenziswa i-access token, nokushintshwa noma ukufaniswa okungeqile ku-10 ngomzuzu.
privacy.storedTrial: Ukuzama ("Kuzame manje"): ayikho i-imeyili noma iphasiwedi, kuphela igama eliqanjiwe elifana no-"speckled quiet kilns". Uma ungena ku-akhawunti kusiphequluli esifanayo ngesikhathi uzama, lokho okwenze ekuzameni kungena ku-akhawunti.
privacy.storedResets: Izixhumanisi zokusetha kabusha iphasiwedi nezama-imeyili: iyiphi i-akhawunti ecelile, nini, ikheli isixhumanisi sokuqinisekisa ikheli esathunyelwa kulo, nesigxivizo sesixhumanisi ngasinye (hhayi isixhumanisi uqobo).
privacy.storedLogs: Ama-log: iseva yewebhu ibhala isicelo ngasinye: ikheli lakho le-IP, isikhathi, ikhasi elicelwe negama lesiphequluli sakho. Uhlelo lubhala amaphutha nekhasi elenzeke kulo, hhayi ikheli lakho le-imeyili.
privacy.storedDeletions: Ama-akhawunti asusiwe: inombolo ye-id ye-akhawunti nokuthi yasuswa nini, hhayi okunye, ukuze i-backup ebuyisiwe ingabuyisi i-akhawunti.
privacy.storedMail: Izinkinga ze-imeyili: uma i-imeyili eya ekhelini lakho ibuyela emuva noma ibikwa njenge-spam, insizakalo ye-imeyili ye-Amazon ifaka ikheli ohlwini lwamakheli angasathunyelwa, futhi ithumela umnikazi isaziso esinekheli.
privacy.storedInbound: Ama-imeyili owathumela ku-Glazecalc: ama-imeyili aya ku-privacy@glazecalcapp.com nakwamanye amakheli e-Glazecalc ahlolwa yi-Amazon ukuthi ayi-spam noma anamagciwane, agcinwe endaweni eyimfihlo, bese edluliselwa ku-inbox yomnikazi (Gmail).
privacy.basisContract: Ukuqhuba i-akhawunti yakho, ukugcina lokho okulondolozayo, nama-imeyili nge-akhawunti yakho kuyinsizakalo oyicelile: isisekelo somthetho yinkontileka phakathi kwakho ne-Glazecalc (GDPR Article 6(1)(b)).
privacy.basisInterests: Ukugcina isayithi liphephile futhi lisebenza: ama-log, imikhawulo yokuthi kaningi kangakanani noma ubani angazama ukungena, ama-backup, irekhodi lama-akhawunti asusiwe nohlu lwamakheli angasathunyelwa. Lokhu kuncike entshisekelweni esemthethweni ye-Glazecalc yokuphepha, ukuvimbela ukuxhashazwa nokungalahlekelwa umsebenzi wakho (Article 6(1)(f)). Kugcinwa isikhashana futhi akusetshenziselwa okunye. Ungakuphikisa ngokubhalela ekhelini elingenhla.
privacy.basisNone: Akukho okumayelana nawe okunqunywa ngokuzenzakalela, akukho ukwakhiwa kwephrofayela, futhi akukho okusetshenziselwa ukukhangisa.
privacy.hosting: I-Glazecalc isebenza ku-Amazon Web Services (AWS): iseva (EC2), ama-backup (S3) ne-imeyili (Simple Email Service), konke e-United States, e-Oregon (us-west-2). I-AWS iphatha imininingwane kuphela egameni le-Glazecalc, ngaphansi <dpa>kwemigomo yayo yokucubungula imininingwane</dpa>. Akekho omunye oyitholayo.
privacy.transfer: Uma uhlala e-EU, e-UK noma e-Switzerland, imininingwane yakho iya e-United States. I-Amazon ithi inesitifiketi ngaphansi kwe-<dpf>EU–US Data Privacy Framework</dpf> nezandiso zayo ze-UK ne-Switzerland, futhi imigomo ye-AWS ifaka i-Standard Contractual Clauses ye-EU, ebingasebenza namanje uma i-Framework, manje ephikiswa enkantolo, ingachithwa. Umnikazi ne-AWS bobabili base-US, futhi umthetho wase-US ungabaphoqa ukuthi banikeze imininingwane.
privacy.noThirdParties: Isiphequluli sakho asilayishi lutho kwamanye amawebhusayithi: awekho amafonti, izikripthi, izithombe noma ukuhlaziywa okuvela kwenye indawo, futhi izilungiselelo zokuphepha zesayithi ziyakuvimba. Izixhumanisi eziya ku-GitHub nakwamanye amasayithi zilandelwa kuphela uma uzichofoza.
privacy.appsIntro: Ungavumela uhlelo lwe-AI, njenge-Claude noma i-ChatGPT, lusebenzise amarekhodi akho e-Glazecalc. Uhlelo luyacela ukuxhuma, bese ungena futhi uthi yebo ekhasini le-Glazecalc uqobo. Lungabe selufunda amarekhodi akho; lungawashintsha kuphela uma nalokho ukuvumela. Akukho okuxhunywayo ngaphandle uma ukukhetha. Njalo uma uxhuma uhlelo, i-Glazecalc ikuthumelela i-imeyili yesaziso esilubiza ngegama, esisho ukuthi lungenzani, futhi esixhumanisa lapho ungaluhoxisa khona.
privacy.appsStored: Lokho okugcinwa ngohlelo ngalunye oluxhunyiwe: igama uhlelo oluzinika lona; kuhlelo oluzibiza ngekheli lewebhu, lelo kheli, i-Glazecalc efunda kulo imininingwane yalo; kuhlelo oluzibhalisayo, kuphela lokho olukusho ngalo, i-Glazecalc engakwazi ukukuhlola; igama lomsingathi lekheli isiphequluli sakho esibuyiselwa kulo ngemva kokuthi uthi yebo; lokho olungakwenza (ukufunda, noma ukufunda nokushintsha); nini waluxhuma, nini lwagcina ukusetshenziswa nokuthi luphela nini; nokuthi lwahoxiswa yini, nokuthi kungani. Amakhodi alo nama-token agcinwa kuphela njengama-hash endlela eyodwa, hhayi amakhodi noma ama-token uqobo. Lokho olukwakhayo, olukushintshayo, olukuyisa kuDoti, olukubuyisayo noma olukuhlehlisayo kubhalwa ohlwini lwalokho ama-token nezinhlelo okwenzile, ngenhla, futhi irekhodi ngalinye oliyisa kuDoti limakwa ngoxhumano olulisusile. Ngenkathi usathi yebo, iseva igcina inothi lesicelo sohlelo futhi, uma usuphendulile, le-akhawunti yakho. Ukuvimbela ukuxhashazwa, izicelo zokuxhuma izinhlelo zibalwa ngekheli le-IP, enkumbulweni yeseva, njengeminye imikhawulo.
privacy.appsFetched: Lokho i-Glazecalc ekulandayo: uma uhlelo oluzibiza ngekheli lewebhu lucela ukuxhuma, naphinde ngezikhathi ezithile ngenkathi luxhunyiwe, iseva ye-Glazecalc ifunda imininingwane yohlelo (ifayela elincane elinegama lalo namakheli) kulelo kheli, kuwebhusayithi yohlelo uqobo. Leso sicelo sisuka kuseva ye-Glazecalc siye kumsingathi wohlelo, futhi asiphethe lutho ngawe. Ifayela ligcinwa enkumbulweni yeseva ihora elingu-1 kuya kwangu-24. Uma othile esexhume uhlelo, ikhophi yefayela nayo igcinwa kusizindalwazi se-Glazecalc, ukuze uhlelo luqhubeke lusebenza uma ifayela lingakwazi ukufundwa isikhashana; liphinde lifundwe njalo emahoreni angu-1 kuya ku-24. Ikhophi iphethe kuphela imininingwane yohlelo uqobo, akukho lutho ngawe, futhi isulwa ngemva kokuphela koxhumano lokugcina nohlelo, kamuva kakhulu ngesikhathi lolo xhumano belungaphelelwa ngaso. Akukho okunye okulandwayo ohlelweni, futhi akukho lutho oluvela kulo olulayisha emakhasini e-Glazecalc.
privacy.appsKept: Isikhathi esingakanani: uxhumano olungafunda kuphela luphela ezinsukwini ezingu-60 ngemva kokuthi uhlelo luvuselele ukufinyelela kwalo okokugcina, olukwenzayo ngenkathi uselusebenzisa; olungashintsha futhi amarekhodi akho luphela ezinsukwini ezingu-90 ngemva kokuthi uluvumele, futhi alulokothi luvuselelwe. Njengakwi-access token, irekhodi lalo ligcinwa izinsuku ezingu-30 ngemva kokuthi uxhumano luphele noma belungaphela, ukuze ubone ukuthi lwama nini. Ikhodi igcinwa umzuzu, i-access token ihora, ne-refresh token isikhathi eside njengoxhumano. Ukuhoxisa uxhumano kuyazisula ngaso leso sikhathi; uma luphelelwa, ziyayeka ukusebenza futhi zihambe kungakapheli ihora. Uhlelo oluzibhalisile lukhohlwa ezinsukwini ezingu-7 ngemva kokuzibhalisa uma kungekho oluxhumayo, noma ezinsukwini ezingu-30 ngemva kokusetshenziswa kwalo okokugcina. Inothi elenziwe ngenkathi uthi yebo liyahamba ngemva kwemizuzu engu-15. Lokho uhlelo olukwenzile kugcinwa izinsuku ezingu-90. Ukusula i-akhawunti yakho kusula konke.
privacy.appsEnd: Ukukuqeda: Izinhlelo ezixhunyiwe, ekhasini lakho le-akhawunti, libhala uhlelo ngalunye nalokho olukwenzile, libuyisa lokho olukuyise kuDoti, futhi lihoxise uhlelo olulodwa noma zonke; uhlelo oluhoxisayo luyama ngaso leso sikhathi. Ukusetha kabusha iphasiwedi noma "Phuma yonke indawo" kuqeda lonke uxhumano, njengoba kwenza kuzo zonke ama-access token; ukushintsha iphasiwedi yakho akukwenzi. Ukuxhuma futhi uhlelo olufanayo kuqeda uxhumano lwalo lwangaphambili, futhi uhlelo lungaqeda olwalo.
privacy.appsTheirs: Lokho uhlelo olukwenzayo ngamarekhodi akho kuncike ohlelweni nakomenzi walo. Uhlelo ngolwenye inkampani, ebhekele ngaphansi kwenqubomgomo yayo yobumfihlo lokho okutshela khona nalokho i-Glazecalc ekuthumelayo ngesicelo sakho; i-Glazecalc ayinalo izwi kukho.
privacy.choiceHeading: Lapho i-akhawunti yakho igcinwa khona, nokukhetha kwakho
privacy.choiceProject: I-Glazecalc iyiphrojekthi yamahhala, enomthombo ovulekile. Ama-akhawunti, nakho konke akuphethe, agcinwa kumaseva ase-United States, noma ngabe uhlala kuphi, njengoba kuchazwe ngenhla.
privacy.choiceNoAccount: Awudingi i-akhawunti ukuze ufunde imihlahlandlela, futhi ungazama isibali ngokuthi "Kuzame manje", ngaphandle kwekheli le-imeyili noma iphasiwedi. Ukuzama kugcinwa kumaseva afanayo izinsuku ezingu-14.
privacy.choiceOwnCopy: Noma ubani angaqhuba ikhophi yakhe ye-Glazecalc, kukhompyutha noma kuseva yakhe: ikhodi imahhala ku-<source>GitHub</source>.
privacy.choiceDecision: Ukuthi uvule i-akhawunti lapha yini, wazi ukuthi igcinwa e-United States, kuyisinqumo sakho.
privacy.choiceNoWarranty: I-Glazecalc inikezwa njengoba injalo, ngaphandle kwewaranti. Abanakekeli bayo abemukeli umthwalo noma isibopho ngesinqumo sakho sokuvula i-akhawunti, noma ngalapho imininingwane yayo igcinwa khona.
privacy.keptAccount: I-akhawunti yakho nalokho okulondolozayo: kuze kube yilapho ukusula. Ama-akhawunti awasuswa ngenxa yokungasetshenziswa.
privacy.keptTrash: UDoti nezinguqulo zangaphambili: irekhodi elikhishiwe izinsuku ezingu-30 ngemva kokuthi ulikhiphe, noma kuze kube yilapho ulisula unomphela noma uthulula uDoti; izinguqulo zangaphambili izinsuku ezingu-90, futhi kuphela ezingu-20 zokugcina zerekhodi ngalinye (nalena yangaphambi kwezinguquko ze-access token) nezingu-20,000 zokugcina ze-akhawunti yonke, kodwa hhayi isikhathi eside kunerekhodi: ngenkathi lisekuDoti izinguqulo zalo ziyahamba uma lihamba. Kokubili kuhamba ngaso leso sikhathi uma usula i-akhawunti yakho.
privacy.keptShares: Izixhumanisi zokwabelana: kuze kube yilapho uyeka ukwabelana ngeresiphi, uyenzela isixhumanisi esisha, uyiyisa kuDoti noma usula i-akhawunti yakho. Ukubuyisa iresiphi kusuka kuDoti akuyabelani futhi. Ukusetha kabusha iphasiwedi yakho noma ukuphuma yonke indawo nakho kumisa zonke izixhumanisi zakho; ukushintsha iphasiwedi yakho akukwenzi.
privacy.keptTokens: Ama-access token nezinhlelo ezixhunyiwe: ngakunye kugcinwa kuze kuphelelwe bese kugcinwa ezinye izinsuku ezingu-30 (yonke i-access token yomuntu siqu iphelelwa kungakapheli unyaka ubuningi; isikhathi uhlelo oluxhunyiwe oluhlala ngaso sikhona ngaphansi kokuthi "Ukuxhuma uhlelo lwe-AI"), noma kuze kube yilapho usula i-akhawunti yakho. Ukusetha kabusha iphasiwedi noma "Phuma yonke indawo" kuzimisa zonke ngaso leso sikhathi.
privacy.keptActivity: Lokho ama-token nezinhlelo okwenzile: izinsuku ezingu-90, noma kuze kube yilapho usula i-akhawunti yakho.
privacy.keptPending: Izinguquko ezilinde imvume yakho: imizuzu engu-30 ubuningi, bese kungashintshwa lutho futhi ziyasuswa; lokho ushintsho olungakwenza kususwa ngokushesha nje uma uluvumela noma uluchitha.
privacy.keptLimits: Imikhawulo yokuthi kaningi kangakanani: izibalo zigcinwa enkumbulweni yeseva kuphela, umzuzu ongu-1 kuya emahoreni angu-24, futhi ziyalahleka uma iqala kabusha.
privacy.keptTrial: Ukuzama: izinsuku ezingu-14 kusukela ekuqaleni kwakho, bese kuyasulwa nakho konke okukukho, ngaphandle uma uvula i-akhawunti ukuze ukugcine.
privacy.keptResets: Izixhumanisi zokusetha kabusha iphasiwedi nezama-imeyili: isixhumanisi sokusetha kabusha sisebenza imizuzu engu-30 futhi irekhodi laso lisulwa ngemva kwehora cishe; isixhumanisi sokuqinisekisa ikheli siyasebenza, futhi sigcinwa, amahora angu-24.
privacy.keptSignIn: Ukungena ngezinyathelo ezimbili: uhlelo ngalunye lwe-authenticator, i-passkey neqoqo lamakhodi okubuyisela kuze kube yilapho ukukhipha, uvala ukungena ngezinyathelo ezimbili noma usula i-akhawunti yakho. Ukungena okulinde isinyathelo sesibili kusulwa ngemva kwemizuzu engu-5, nohlelo noma i-passkey oqale ukuyengeza kodwa ungaqedanga, ngemva kwemizuzu engu-10 ubuningi.
privacy.keptBackups: Ama-backup: amakhophi abethelwe esizindalwazi agcinwa izinsuku ezingu-30, namakhophi ediski yeseva izinsuku ezingu-7. Ngakho i-akhawunti esusiwe iyaphela kuwo wonke ama-backup kungakapheli izinsuku ezingu-30.
privacy.keptDeletions: Irekhodi le-akhawunti esusiwe: izinsuku ezingu-37, isikhathi esingaphezudlwana kwanoma iyiphi i-backup.
privacy.keptLogs: Ama-log: awaseva yewebhu, izinsuku ezingu-14. Ama-log ohlelo nawesizindalwazi uqobo akhawulelwe ngosayizi (50 MB ngalinye), okuthi kusayithi elithulile kubuyele emuva izinsuku ezimbalwa. Amakhophi ediski yeseva agcina ama-log kuze kufike ezinsukwini ezingu-7 ngaphezulu.
privacy.keptMail: Uhlu lwamakheli angasathunyelwa: kuze kube yilapho umnikazi esusa ikheli, akwenza njalo ngenyanga kumakheli angasekho e-akhawunti. Umnikazi usula izaziso zokubuyela emuva kungakapheli izinsuku ezingu-30.
privacy.keptInbound: Ama-imeyili owathumela ku-Glazecalc: izinsuku ezingu-30 endaweni ye-Amazon, naku-inbox yomnikazi isikhathi esidingekayo ukuze akuphendule. Esicelweni esimayelana nemininingwane yakho, inothi elifushane (lafika nini, kwacelwani nokuthi kwenziwani) ligcinwa iminyaka emithathu.
privacy.rightsIntro: Ungabona, ulungise, uthathe futhi usule imininingwane yakho. Iningi lakho ungakwenza wena ekhasini lakho <account>le-akhawunti</account>:
privacy.rightsExport: Kubone futhi uhambe nakho: Landa imininingwane yami ilondoloza konke efayeleni elilodwa (JSON), kufaka phakathi amagama nezinsuku zezindlela zakho zokungena ngezinyathelo ezimbili (hhayi okhiye noma amakhodi azo), namaresiphi akho nokokwakha njengama-spreadsheet (CSV).
privacy.rightsCorrect: Kulungise: shintsha izilungiselelo zakho namarekhodi akho noma nini. Ukuze ushintshe ikheli lakho le-imeyili, vula isixhumanisi esithunyelwe ekhelini elisha; ikheli elidala, uma laliqinisekisiwe, liyatshelwa ngoshintsho, futhi yonke idivayisi iyakhishwa.
privacy.rightsDelete: Kusule: Susa i-akhawunti yami isusa i-akhawunti yakho nakho konke okulondolozile ngaso leso sikhathi, futhi "Lahla ukuzama" kwenza okufanayo ekuzameni. Amakhophi akuma-backup ayaphela kungakapheli izinsuku ezingu-30.
privacy.rightsSignOut: Phuma yonke indawo: iqeda izikhathi zokungena ze-akhawunti yakho kuyo yonke idivayisi.
privacy.rightsAsk: Kunoma yini enye, njengokucela ukuthi imininingwane yakho ingasetshenziswa ngenkathi iphutha lilungiswa, noma ukuphikisa indlela esetshenziswa ngayo, bhalela ku-<mail>privacy@glazecalcapp.com</mail>. Kumahhala, futhi uzothola impendulo kungakapheli inyanga. Uzocelwa kuphela ukubonisa ukuthi i-akhawunti ngeyakho, ngokungena noma ngokuvula isixhumanisi esithunyelwe ekhelini layo, hhayi i-ID.
privacy.rightsComplain: Uma unganelisekile, ungakhalaza kwisiphathimandla sokuvikelwa kwemininingwane: e-EU, <edpb>isiphathimandla sezwe lakho</edpb>, nase-UK, i-<ico>Information Commissioner's Office</ico>.
privacy.storageIntro: I-Glazecalc isetha ama-cookie amabili, elesibili kuphela ngenkathi ungena nge-Google, i-GitHub noma i-Microsoft, futhi igcina amanani ambalwa amancane kusiphequluli sakho. Ngalinye lilapho ngenxa yokuthile okucelile: ukuhlala ungenile, ukungena nge-Google, i-GitHub noma i-Microsoft, noma ukukhumbula ukukhetha okwenzile. Akukho elikulandelelayo futhi akukho elabiwayo, ngakho umthetho awudingi ukuthi kubuzwe kuqala, futhi alikho ibhanela lama-cookie.
privacy.storageNote: Ungasula noma yikuphi kwalokhu ezilungiselelweni zesiphequluli sakho noma nini. Ukusula i-akhawunti yakho kususa inothi lokungena nesilungiselelo ngasinye esigcinwe lapha.

cookie.purpose: Ikugcina ungenile. Iphethe i-token yakho yokungena. Izikripthi ekhasini azikwazi ukuyifunda, futhi isiphequluli sakho siyithumela kuphela kuseva ye-Glazecalc uqobo, nge-HTTPS, futhi asilokothi siyithumele nesicelo esiqala kwelinye isayithi.
cookie.lasts: Isethwa uma ungena, uvula i-akhawunti noma uqala ukuzama. Kuze kube yilapho uvala isiphequluli sakho, noma izinsuku ezingu-7 uma uthikha okuthi "Ngigcine ngingenile kule divayisi"; izinsuku ezingu-14 ekuzameni. Ukuphuma kuyayisusa.

session.purpose: Iqaphela ukuthi ungenile, ku-akhawunti noma ekuzameni, ukuze uhlelo lwazi ukubuza iseva. Ayiphethe i-token noma iphasiwedi.
session.lasts: Kuze kube yilapho uphuma noma isikhathi siphela.

trial.purpose: Ngesikhathi sokuzama, igama lakho nosuku lokuphela, ukuze kuboniswe.
trial.lasts: Kuze kube yilapho ukuzama kuphela, noma kugcinwa noma kulahlwa.

settings.purpose: Isilungiselelo osishintshe kulesi siphequluli, ukuze ikhasi elilandelayo lisibonise ngokushesha, ngaphambi kokuba iseva iphendule. theme ne-palette kufaka umbala ekhasini ngaphambi kokuba livele, futhi i-language ivula amakhasi ngolimi lwakho.
settings.lasts: Kuze kube yilapho usishintsha. Ukuphuma kubuyisa lokho okukhethile ngenkathi ungangenile, uma kukhona, futhi kususe okunye.

visitor.purpose: Ulimi olukhethile, noma ukuthi uvale isaziso sokuhumusha, ngenkathi ungangenile, ukuze kubuye uma uphuma.
visitor.lasts: Kuze kube yilapho usula isitoreji sesiphequluli sakho noma usula i-akhawunti kulesi siphequluli.

region.lasts: Kuze kube yilapho ubuyisela isihlungi kuzo zonke izifunda.

includeAdditives.purpose: Ukuthi amaresiphi amasha abala yini izithasiselo zawo ku-UMF, njengoba ukhethe okokugcina.
includeAdditives.lasts: Kuze kube yilapho usula isitoreji sesiphequluli sakho.

print.purpose: Ukukhetha kwakho kokugcina kokuphrinta iresiphi: iresiphi yonke, i-batch noma i-worksheet, nosayizi we-batch.
print.lasts: Kuze kube yilapho usula isitoreji sesiphequluli sakho.

token.purpose: I-token yokungena evela enguqulweni endala ye-Glazecalc. Ayisabhalwa manje.

readEnglish.purpose: Ukuthi ukhethe ukufunda ikhasi elihunyushiwe ngesiNgisi, ukuze uhlelo luyeke ukukuyisa olimini lwakho.

reloadedFor.purpose: Ngemva kokukhishwa kwenguqulo entsha yesayithi, yiliphi ikhasi elalayishwa kabusha futhi nini, ukuze ikhasi lilayishe kabusha kanye ngomzuzu ubuningi.

oauthCookie.purpose: Kuphela ngenkathi ungena nge-Google, i-GitHub noma i-Microsoft: ibophela impendulo yomhlinzeki kusiphequluli sakho, ukuze kungabikho omunye ongaqeda ukungena kwakho noma akuqalele kona. Izikripthi ekhasini azikwazi ukuyifunda.
oauthCookie.lasts: Isethwa uma ucindezela okuthi "Qhubeka nge-Google", "Qhubeka nge-GitHub" noma "Ngena nge-Microsoft", noma uxhumanisa okukodwa ekhasini lakho le-akhawunti. Isuswa uma ukungena kuqeda, noma ngemva kwemizuzu engu-10.

privacy.children: I-Glazecalc iyithuluzi lababumbi futhi ayenzelwe izingane.
privacy.changes: Uma lesi saziso sishintsha, usuku olusekhanda lekhasi luyashintsha nalo.
privacy.storedProviders: I-Google, i-GitHub noma i-Microsoft, uma ungena ngokukodwa: i-id yomhlinzeki yakho uqobo (inombolo noma ikhodi engalokothi ishintshe; ku-Microsoft, kanye ne-id yohlu lwamagama i-akhawunti yakho engelalo: elenhlangano yakho, noma ele-Microsoft uqobo kuma-akhawunti omuntu siqu), nini wayixhumanisa nokuthi nini wagcina ukungena ngayo, nokuthi i-akhawunti yakho inayo yini iphasiwedi yayo. Akukho okunye okuvela kumhlinzeki okugcinwayo: hhayi igama lakho, isithombe sakho noma noma yimuphi ukhiye we-akhawunti yakho lapho. Ngenkathi ungena, iseva igcina inothi lokungena, nge-imeyili umhlinzeki athi ngeyakho lapho idingeka: ku-akhawunti entsha, lapho iba yi-imeyili ye-akhawunti yakho (i-imeyili evela ku-Microsoft ayithenjwa nje: uyiqinisekisa ngesixhumanisi esikuthumelela sona nge-imeyili, njengalapho ubhalisa), noma, uma i-akhawunti ye-Glazecalc isivele inaleyo imeyili, ukuxhumanisa i-Google noma i-GitHub nayo uma usungene kuleyo akhawunti (i-Microsoft ixhunyaniswa kuphela ekhasini le-akhawunti). Inothi, ne-imeyili ekulo, lisulwa kungakapheli imizuzu engu-10 cishe.
privacy.providers: Ukungena nge-Google, i-GitHub noma i-Microsoft kuwukukhetha kwakho, futhi kwenzeka kuphela uma ucindezela inkinobho yakho. Isiphequluli sakho sibe sesiya kulowo mhlinzeki, othumela i-Glazecalc i-id yakhe yakho ne-imeyili yakho. Ngamunye uyinkampani ehlukile, ebhekele lokho okwabelana nayo ngakho ngaphansi kwenqubomgomo yayo yobumfihlo. Asikho isikripthi noma isithombe esivela kunoma yimuphi wabo esilayisha emakhasini e-Glazecalc.
privacy.keptProviders: I-Google, i-GitHub noma i-Microsoft: ukuxhumanisa ngakunye kuze kube yilapho ukusula noma usula i-akhawunti yakho. Ukungena okuqhubekayo kusulwa ngemva kwemizuzu engu-10.

terms.title: Imigomo yokusebenzisa
terms.short: I-Glazecalc imahhala ukuyisebenzisa. Yisebenzisele ama-glaze akho, amarekhodi nokufunda, ube nobulungiswa kuseva wonke umuntu ayabelanayo, futhi ungazami ukuyiphula.
terms.who: I-Glazecalc iyiphrojekthi yamahhala, enomthombo ovulekile, engenzi nzuzo, eqhutshwa ngumnikazi wayo, u-Aaron Filson, e-United States. Le migomo ingeyokusebenzisa isayithi ku-glazecalcapp.com. Ngokulisebenzisa, uyavumelana nayo; uma ungavumelani, sicela ungalisebenzisi.
terms.code: <source>Ikhodi yomthombo</source> ye-Glazecalc imahhala ngaphansi kwe-MIT License, evumela noma ubani ukuthi ayisebenzise, ayikhophe, ayishintshe futhi ayabelane ngayo, futhi aqhube ikhophi yakhe. Leyo layisense ingeyekhodi. Le migomo ingeyaleli sayithi: iseva yalo, ne-akhawunti oyenza kulo.
terms.useOwn: Yisebenzisele ukubala ama-glaze, ukugcina amarekhodi akho nokufunda, njengento oyithandayo, ekufundiseni noma ebhizinisini.
terms.useAccount: Umuntu oyedwa ku-akhawunti, onekheli le-imeyili elingelakhe. Gcina iphasiwedi yakho, izindlela zakho zokungena nama-access token akho kuwe: ubhekele lokho okwenziwa ngakho.
terms.useApps: Ukuxhuma uhlelo lwe-AI noma olunye uhlelo ku-akhawunti yakho kuwukukhetha kwakho. Uhlelo oluvumelayo lwenza egameni lakho: ubhekele lokho olukwenzayo ku-akhawunti yakho, njengakuma-access token akho. Ungaqeda ukufinyelela kwalo noma nini ekhasini lakho le-akhawunti.
terms.useContent: Londoloza futhi wabelane kuphela ngalokho onelungelo kukho. Iresiphi owabelana ngayo ngesixhumanisi ingafundwa yinoma ubani onesixhumanisi.
terms.yours: Lokho okulondolozayo kuhlala kungokwakho. Uvumela i-Glazecalc ukuthi ikugcine, futhi ikubonise abantu owabelana nabo ngakho, kuphela ukuze iqhube isayithi.
terms.leave: Ungayeka ukusebenzisa i-Glazecalc noma nini. Susa i-akhawunti yami, ekhasini lakho le-akhawunti, isusa i-akhawunti yakho nakho konke okukuyo.
terms.fairIntro: I-Glazecalc isebenza kuseva eyodwa encane wonke umuntu ayabelanayo. Ngokuyisebenzisa, uyavuma ukuthi ngeke:
terms.fairAttack: uzame ukungena kuseva, esayithini noma kuma-akhawunti abanye abantu, noma ukulicisha. Uma uthola inkinga yokuphepha, sicela uyibike njengoba <security>inqubomgomo yokuphepha</security> icela, futhi ungayihloli emininingwaneni yabanye abantu.
terms.fairLoad: ulithumelele izicelo eziningi kunalezo elingakwazi ukuzithwala, noma udlule imikhawulo yokuthi izinto zingenziwa kaningi kangakanani. Leyo mikhawulo igcina isayithi lisebenzela wonke umuntu, futhi ingashintsha.
terms.fairScrape: ukhophe isayithi lonke nge-crawler noma isikripthi. Konke elakhiwe ngakho, ikhodi yalo nemininingwane yalo, sekuku-<source>GitHub</source> kakade.
terms.fairAccounts: wenze ama-akhawunti engeziwe noma ukuzama ukuze udlule umkhawulo, noma usebenzise i-akhawunti yomunye umuntu.
terms.fairMail: usebenzise ukubhalisa, ukusetha kabusha amaphasiwedi noma izixhumanisi zokwabelana ukuthumela abantu ama-imeyili noma izixhumanisi abangazicelanga.
terms.fairHarm: ugcine noma wabelane nganoma yini engekho emthethweni noma eyingozi, noma yini engeyona eyakho ukuthi wabelane ngayo.
terms.fairScripts: Izikripthi nabasizi be-AI bamukelekile ngaphakathi kwale migomo. Banike i-access token yakho, ukuze lokho abakwenzayo kubalwe njengokwakho.
terms.stop: Ukuze kugcinwe isayithi lisebenza, i-Glazecalc ingehlisa isivinini noma yenqabe izicelo, imise isixhumanisi esabiwe, noma ivale i-akhawunti ephula le migomo noma efaka isayithi engozini. Ukuvala i-akhawunti kuyayisula. Lapho kunengqondo khona, umnikazi uzokuthumelela i-imeyili kuqala futhi akunike isikhathi sokulanda imininingwane yakho.
terms.available: I-Glazecalc imahhala futhi isebenza ngesabelomali esincane. Ingavaleka ngezinye izikhathi, ngenxa yokulungiswa noma ngengozi, izici zayo zingashintsha, futhi ngelinye ilanga isayithi lingavalwa. Uma kwenzeka, umnikazi uhlela ukuthumela i-imeyili kubanikazi bama-akhawunti kuqala futhi abanike isikhathi sokulanda amarekhodi abo. Usizo lunikezwa lapho umnikazi ekwazi, hhayi ngohlelo. Gcina amakhophi anoma yini ebalulekile: Landa imininingwane yami, ekhasini lakho le-akhawunti, ikunika konke okulondolozile.
terms.warranty: I-Glazecalc inikezwa njengoba injalo, ngaphandle kwewaranti yanoma yiluphi uhlobo. Ngokwezinga umthetho owuvumelayo, abanakekeli bayo abanasibopho sanoma yikuphi ukulahlekelwa noma umonakalo ovela ekusebenziseni isayithi noma ekuthembeleni kulo. Akukho kule migomo okususa amalungelo onawo ngokomthetho lapho uhlala khona.
terms.privacy: <privacy>Isaziso sobumfihlo</privacy> sisho ukuthi i-Glazecalc igcinani ngawe, kungani, nokuthi isikhathi esingakanani.
terms.changes: Uma le migomo ishintsha, usuku olusekhanda lekhasi luyashintsha nalo. Koshintsho olubalulekile kubanikazi bama-akhawunti, umnikazi uzozama ukubathumelela i-imeyili ngaphambi kokuba lusebenze.
terms.contact: Imibuzo ngale migomo: <hello>hello@glazecalcapp.com</hello>. Ukubika ukuxhashazwa kwesayithi: <abuse>abuse@glazecalcapp.com</abuse>. Ngezinkinga zokuphepha, bona <security>inqubomgomo yokuphepha</security>.

notFound.heading: Ikhasi alitholakalanga
notFound.text: Alikho ikhasi kuleli kheli. Kungenzeka ukuthi lisusiwe, noma isixhumanisi sibhalwe kabi.

advice.title: Iseluleko nge-glaze
advice.lead: Amathiphu awusizo okuxuba, ukufaka i-glaze nokushisa, kanye nanoma yisiphi iseluleko sakho.
advice.signUp: <signup>Vula i-akhawunti yamahhala</signup> noma <signin>ungene</signin> ukuze ugcine iseluleko sakho.

assistants.title: Sebenzisa i-Glazecalc kumsizi wakho we-AI
assistants.lead: Abasizi be-AI abafana no-Claude, i-GitHub Copilot, i-Cursor ne-Gemini bangasebenzisa izibalo ze-Glazecalc ngqo, nge-Model Context Protocol (MCP).
assistants.what: Ngaphandle kwe-akhawunti, umsizi angabheka okokwakha emtatsheni, abale i-UMF yeresiphi, ayihlole ngokubhekisela emikhawulweni yokushisa kwayo, aphakamise okungathatha indawo yokokwakha okungasakhiqizwa, enze kabusha iresiphi ngokokwakha okubizayo, aguqule phakathi kwama-cone namazinga okushisa, futhi asesha futhi afunde imihlahlandlela. Akukho akuthumelayo okulondolozwayo; njengakuwo wonke amakhasi, i-log yeseva yewebhu ibhala ikheli le-IP lesicelo ngasinye, isikhathi nekheli (hhayi lokho okuthunyelwe), izinsuku ezingu-14.
assistants.solve: Angenza futhi iresiphi ye-UMF noma yokuhlaziywa kwama-oxide omnika kona, ngokokwakha okubizayo, futhi asho ukuthi isondela kangakanani, i-oxide ngayinye. Uma i-akhawunti yakho ixhunyiwe, angasebenzisa okokwakha onakho.
assistants.mine: Nge-access token evela ekhasini lakho <account>le-akhawunti</account>, angafunda futhi amaresiphi akho, okokwakha, incwadi, amarekhodi okushisa nokokwakha onakho. I-token eyenzelwe ukufunda kuphela ayilokothi ishintshe noma isuse lutho.
assistants.caution: Ukuhlola imikhawulo kuyizexwayiso ezivela emikhawulweni eshicilelwe, njengasohlelweni, hhayi ubufakazi bokuthi i-glaze iphephile ekudleni. Hlola ngokushisa yonke i-glaze, futhi uhlolise ama-glaze ezindawo zokudla ukuphuma kwezinsimbi (leaching).
assistants.write: I-token eyenzelwe "Funda futhi ushintshe" ivumela futhi umsizi wakho ukuthi alondoloze iresiphi ayibale nawe, i-Glazecalc ibala i-UMF yayo, ashintshe eyodwa yamaresiphi akho noma okokwakha kwakho, engeze encwadini yakho, amake okokwakha njengokukhona, futhi ayise irekhodi kuDoti. Akalokothi asule lutho unomphela: noma yini ayiyisa kuDoti ingabuyiswa phakathi nezinsuku ezingu-30, futhi ushintsho ngalunye lugcina irekhodi njengoba lalinjalo, ukuze ukwazi ukuluhlehlisa kuwebhusayithi. Lokho i-token ngayinye ekwenzile kugcinelwa wena, ekhasini elithi Izinhlelo ezixhunyiwe nakokuthi Landa imininingwane yami.
assistants.writeSafely: Yenza i-token engashintsha amarekhodi akho kuphela kumsizi noma isikripthi osithembayo, futhi umcele ukuthi asho ukuthi uzoshintshani ngaphambi kokuba akwenze. Yinike isikhathi esifushane esanele (i-token enjalo ihlala izinsuku ezingu-90 ubuningi), ugcine i-token yokufunda kuphela kukho konke okunye, futhi uyihoxise uma umsebenzi usuqediwe. Landa imininingwane yakho ekhasini lakho le-akhawunti kuqala uma ufuna ikhophi njengoba injalo.
assistants.connectIntro: Kunezindlela ezimbili zokuvumela umsizi afinyelele amarekhodi akho. Zombili ziqala ngokufunda kuphela.
assistants.connectSignIn: Ngena kusuka ohlelweni. I-Claude, i-ChatGPT nezinye izinhlelo eziningi zixhuma ngokukuthumela ku-Glazecalc. Ngena, bese i-Glazecalc ikubonisa ukuthi yiluphi uhlelo olucelayo, ikheli lalo nalapho impendulo yakho iya khona, nesexwayiso uma impendulo iya kukhompyutha yakho. Uhlelo lungafunda amarekhodi akho; lungawashintsha kuphela uma uphinde uthikhe okuthi "Luvumele futhi lushintshe amarekhodi ami". Bese ukhetha okuthi Vumela noma Ungavumeli.
assistants.connectToken: I-access token. Kumsizi noma isikripthi esithumela i-header (Claude Code, VS Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI), yenza i-token ekhasini lakho le-akhawunti bese uyifaka kulokhu kusetha okungezansi.
assistants.connectSee: Lonke uhlelo ne-token oyixhumayo kubhalwe ku-<apps>Izinhlelo ezixhunyiwe</apps>, nalokho okwenzile, futhi ungahoxisa noma yikuphi khona lapho noma nini. Uhlelo ngalunye olusha oluxhumayo luyakuthumelela ne-imeyili.
assistants.address: Nika umsizi wakho leli kheli, usebenzisa i-Streamable HTTP transport:
assistants.token: Ukuze umvumele afunde amarekhodi akho, yenza i-token ekhasini lakho <account>le-akhawunti</account> bese uyikhophela. Umsizi wakho uyithumela ku-header ye-Authorization, njengo-Bearer olandelwa yi-token. Yigcine ingangeni emafayeleni owabelana ngawo noma owa-commit, njengephasiwedi.
assistants.claudeCodeToken: Nge-access token, ukuze ufunde namarekhodi akho:
assistants.vscode: Ku-.vscode/mcp.json kufolda, noma ezilungiselelweni zakho zomsebenzisi. I-VS Code icela i-token kanye futhi iyigcine ifihliwe; shiya ngaphandle ama-header nama-input ukuze usebenzise kuphela amathuluzi angadingi i-akhawunti:
assistants.cursor: Ku-~/.cursor/mcp.json, noma ku-.cursor/mcp.json kuphrojekthi. Shiya ngaphandle ama-header ukuze usebenzise kuphela amathuluzi angadingi i-akhawunti:
assistants.gemini: Ku-~/.gemini/settings.json. Shiya ngaphandle ama-header ukuze usebenzise kuphela amathuluzi angadingi i-akhawunti:
assistants.copyByHand: Akukwazanga ukukhophelwa wena. Kukhethiwe: kukhophele ebhokisini.
assistants.apps: Engeza i-custom connector ngekheli elingenhla. Uma uhlelo lucela, ngena ku-Glazecalc bese ukhetha lokho olungakwenza, njengoba kuchazwe ngenhla.
assistants.dictation: Faka i-skill yamanothi esitudiyo ye-Glazecalc ohlelweni lwakho lwe-AI, bese ukhuluma noma uthayipha njengoba usebenza. Iguqula lokho okushoyo kube amaresiphi, amarekhodi okushisa, imiphumela yama-test tile namanothi, ikufundele ngalinye, futhi ililondoloze ku-akhawunti yakho kuphela uma uthi yebo. Izwi ngelohlelo lwakho: i-Glazecalc ayilokothi ilizwe.
assistants.dictationNeeds: Idinga i-Glazecalc ixhunywe kuthikhwe okuthi "Luvumele futhi lushintshe amarekhodi ami", noma i-token engakwazi "Funda futhi ushintshe". Uma ukhethe ku-Izinhlelo ezixhunyiwe ukuvumela izinguquko, ukulondoloza ngakunye kulinda imvume yakho lapho futhi.
assistants.dictationClaude: Claude (iwebhu nedeskithophu): vula i-code execution ezilungiselelweni, bese ku-Customize, Skills, ukhethe +, Create skill, Upload a skill, bese ukhetha i-ZIP. Engeza ne-Glazecalc njenge-connector.
assistants.dictationClaudeCode: Claude Code: yikhiphe ku-~/.claude/skills/, bese wengeza i-Glazecalc njengoba kuboniswe ngenhla.
assistants.dictationChatGpt: ChatGPT, lapho uhlelo lwakho lunikeza ama-skill: layisha i-ZIP njenge-skill, bese wengeza i-Glazecalc njenge-app.
assistants.dictationPrompt: Kwabanye abasizi, khetha i-prompt ye-Glazecalc ethi "Dictate studio notes": iphethe imiyalelo efanayo.
assistants.stop: Hoxisa i-token ekhasini lakho <account>le-akhawunti</account> noma nini. Yonke i-token iyeka ukusebenza ngosuku olukhethile, futhi zonke ziyama ngaso leso sikhathi uma usetha kabusha iphasiwedi yakho noma uphuma yonke indawo.
assistants.limits: Ikheli ngalinye lingenza izicelo ezingu-60 ngomzuzu no-2,000 ngosuku; i-akhawunti esebenzisa i-token, 300 ngomzuzu no-20,000 ngosuku. Ukushintshwa nokufaniswa kukhawulelwe ku-10 ngomzuzu. Izinguquko ezenziwe ngama-token zikhawulelwe ku-60 ngomzuzu no-5,000 ngosuku ku-akhawunti ngayinye, futhi i-token ngayinye ingayisa amarekhodi angu-100 ngehora kuDoti.
